title: Settings
subtitle: Account, appearance, notifications, and more
appearanceDescription: Choose light or dark mode, or follow your device setting.
notificationsDescription: Choose which alerts reach this device. Your choices are enforced by PitchProof servers, and alerts are rate-limited.
privacyDataDescription: Manage portfolio visibility and discovery below. Review how PitchProof handles your data in our privacy policy.
aboutDescription: Football Passport for players and scouts.
deleteAccountDescription: Permanently delete your PitchProof account and profile data.
deleteAccountMessage: This permanently deletes your PitchProof account and associated data, subject to limited retention described in the Privacy Policy. This cannot be undone. Deleting your account does not cancel an Apple subscription. Cancel renewal separately in Apple subscription settings to avoid further charges. You can delete your account now without waiting for the subscription to expire.
languageDescription: Choose your preferred language. This overrides automatic device detection.
changePasswordDescription: Update your password through Firebase Authentication. PitchProof never stores your password.
changePasswordFailed: Unable to change password. Check your current password and try again.
guestAccountHint: You're browsing as a guest. Create an account or sign in to build and share your Football Passport.

lockScreen.title: Show details on lock screen
lockScreen.hint: When off, notifications only say "You have a new update" until you open PitchProof.
lockScreen.youth: For accounts under 18, notifications never show details on the lock screen.

quietHours.title: Quiet hours (22:00 to 07:00)
quietHours.hint: No push notifications at night. Updates still appear in your activity feed.
